verses.html: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David. O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.text: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David. O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
verses.title: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.html: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
verses.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.html: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.html: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.html: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
verses.text: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.html: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

verses.html: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.html: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
verses.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
